question: A manufacturing company receives notice from a supplier that it will not be able to make a scheduled delivery. The delivery is critical to the buying firm’s production of a key product. The supply manager calls a meeting with team members from production, sales, legal, and other areas to discuss the situation. Which of the following is the BEST approach for the team to take during this meeting? A. Determine whether team members have any contacts with alternate suppliers B. Assess the impact of the situation on each of the functions C. Brainstorm on ways to maintain the production schedule D. Identify ways to delay upcoming demand for the product
